parameters.name: BurstingEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable performance bursting for a disk that supports this feature.

Valid values: `true` and `false`. **Note**: This operation returns an error if you specify this parameter for a disk that does not support performance bursting.

parameters.name: DeleteWithInstance
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to release the disk when its associated instance is released. If you do not specify this parameter, the current setting remains unchanged.

You cannot set this parameter for cloud disks that have the multi-attach feature enabled.

Setting `DeleteWithInstance` to `false` returns an error in the following cases:

The disk is an ephemeral disk (`ephemeral`), or the disk is a non-detachable (`Portable=false`) cloud disk. **Warning**: If you set `DeleteWithInstance` to `false`, the disk is still released with the instance if the instance is protected by a security lock (`"LockReason": "security"` in `OperationLocks`). In this case, the `DeleteWithInstance` setting is ignored.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The new description for the disk. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: DiskId
parameters.description: The ID of the disk whose attributes you want to modify.

parameters.name: DiskName
parameters.description: The new name for the disk. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the `DescribeRegions` operation to obtain the latest list of regions.
